description: How many concurrent players Steam launches with a similar number of followers (within 3x) reached at their first-week peak: the range 8 in 10 landed in, the middle half and the median, with n. The same rule as SteamMaho's public forecast receipts. Pass followers when the person has them; pass wishlists when they only have wishlists (the two are not the same number).

followers.description: The game's Steam follower count, e.g. '12000' or '12k'

wishlists.description: The game's wishlist count when the person has that instead of followers, e.g. '20000'; it is turned into followers with SteamMaho's pool ratio (about 23 wishlists per follower) and the answer says so

name: launch_range_for_followers
title: Launch range for a following
